name: White Glove Gourmand
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create two 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, if another Human died under your control this turn, create a Food token.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, if another Human died under your control this turn, create a Food token.

needs.what: a turn-ledger value counting creatures that died this turn under a given player's control, filtered by the dead creature's last-known characteristics (here subtypes: ["Human"]) and excluding the source itself ("another Human"), usable as an end_step trigger's intervening-if condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: creatures_died_this_turn, nontoken_creatures_died_this_turn and modified_creatures_died_this_turn are keyed only by player and take no creature filter, so they cannot ask whether the dead creature was a Human or someone other than this one; a creature_dies trigger setting a turn flag would be an unprinted ability that misses Humans that died before this creature entered
